problemSignature.symptom: Odd-shape fixture reached DRC/ERC clean routed state but initially stopped before manufacturing export.

rootCause: The fixture runner validated generated boards but did not continue into KiCad manufacturing export when all critical gates were clean.
fixSummary: Export Gerbers, drill, CPL, a documented fixture BOM, and a JLCPCB review ZIP only after DRC errors, ERC errors, and unconnected items are all zero.

testsAdded: fixture runner creates odd-shape preroute KiCad artifacts without fake manufacturing

recipe: Block export if DRC errors, ERC errors, or unconnected items remain.
Export Gerbers and drill files with kicad-cli.
Export CPL from the PCB and create a fixture BOM with sourcing status disclosed as NOT_API_VERIFIED.
Package all manufacturing evidence into a review ZIP.
safetyRules: Do not export ZIPs when KiCad validation has errors.
Do not imply supplier stock/API verification for fixture placeholder rows.
